name: How long does it take to build an attached ADU?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build an attached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building an attached ADU generally ranges from 6 to 12 months, encompassing design, permitting, and construction phases. Design and permitting can take several months due to local regulations and review processes in areas like Los Angeles. The construction itself typically spans 3 to 6 months, depending on the project's scope, weather, and material availability. We strive to complete projects efficiently while maintaining quality.
